planets.name: TOI-5799 c
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-5799 with a 14-day year, found in 2025.

text.card: TOI-5799 c was found in 2025 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 2 planets known around TOI-5799. Its orbit and size follow Yalçinkaya et al. 2025's fit, the archive's default.
